ideas.pitch: An off-grid acoustic and RF mesh network designed to maintain reliable telemetry links for low-earth-orbit ground stations and remote atmospheric balloon probes.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track: Space-related communication and ground-station redundancy.
ideas.title: AstroMesh: LoRa-Based Decentralized Telemetry Relay for CubeSats
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Hardware Track Winner prize with a physical RF build; draws heavily from the EchoMesh winning pattern of creating functional off-grid hardware communication.

ideas.pitch: A real-time edge processing pipeline that ingests TLE satellite data and optical tracking feeds to compute high-risk conjunction warnings using automated trajectory clustering.
ideas.problem_statement: Software Track: Space traffic management and orbital debris tracking.
ideas.title: OrbitalDebris-Net: AI-Driven Conjunction Assessment & Collision Avoidance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a critical real-world aerospace safety issue, featuring a live interactive data visualization demo that appeals directly to industry expert judges.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed navigation and telemetry anomaly detection engine for micro-rovers operating in GPS-denied environments like lunar craters.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track: Robotics and autonomous systems for space exploration.
ideas.title: LunarRover-Edge: Autonomous Fault-Tolerant Navigation for Surface Explorers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines custom embedded hardware logic with automated sensor anomaly detection, matching the proven winning pattern of unusual physical builds with hard engineering.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent telemetry and automated recovery monitoring platform for simulated space habitat life support systems tracking CO2 scrubbers and power grids.
ideas.problem_statement: Software Track: Closed-loop habitat automation and telemetry analysis.
ideas.title: SpaceHab-Telemetry: Closed-Loop Environmental Life Support Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Software Track Winner prize by leveraging a sophisticated multi-agent pipeline and live anomaly diagnosis dashboard that judges can interact with instantly.

ideas.pitch: A custom 3D-printed spectrometer attachment paired with an embedded microcontroller and web UI for real-time spectral analysis of light sources and atmospheric pollution.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track: Low-cost scientific instrumentation for space research and astronomy.
ideas.title: AstroSpec: Compact Low-Cost Stellar Spectroscopy Sensor Kit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Competes for the Best Innovation prize by demonstrating a tangible, low-cost hardware prototype built from scratch during the hackathon window.
